summary: Explore Logiwa MLT1 sandbox per module cluster, map KitStaks code, synthesize gap/build plan

foundation.summary: Foundation (F0-F8) is the serial package that must land before any module work. It covers tooling, migrations and tests (F0); an additive Drizzle schema with about 75 new tables (F1); a seed that reconciles with the ledger (F2); a server platform (F3) with sessions, CSRF, permission catalog, scope, defineRoute and a grid-query grammar; a client platform and UI kit (F4) with Radix primitives, forms, wizard, the upgraded DataGrid and filter builder, shared modals, the full shell and nav-config/page-tabs; domain engines (F5) for ledger, allocation, jobs/tasks, shipping with a sandbox carrier, orders, products, putaway, state machines and change-log; platform services (F6) for files, xlsx export, imports, PDF/ZPL print, scheduler and search; foundation APIs under /api/{me,search,tags,change-log,custom-fields,lookups,saved-views,grid-prefs,background-tasks,exports,imports,files,print,printers,notifications,pickers,ops,cron} (F7); and the F8 gate. Stub files hand cross-module hooks over to their owning modules. Full spec: docs/BUILD_PLAN.md Part A.
items: F0 tooling: package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, next.config.ts (HSTS plus legacy ?tab= redirects), drizzle.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, playwright.config.ts, tests/setup/**, tests/e2e/fixtures/** (auth contexts, dead-click-audit.spec.ts, a11y.ts), tests/unit/foundation/**, scripts/** (verify-ledger.ts), .env.example, src/instrumentation.ts. New deps: radix-ui, cmdk, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, @tanstack/react-query, react-day-picker, @dnd-kit/*, @tanstack/react-virtual, @xyflow/react, exceljs, pdf-lib, bwip-js, vitest, @playwright/test, @axe-core/playwright.

F1 schema: src/server/db/schema.ts, src/server/db/columns.ts (pk/bool/json/stamps/customFields), src/server/db/schema/{identity,org,catalog,facility,inventory,outbound,shipping,inbound,returns,work,counts,kitting,automation,integrations,billing,platform}.ts, src/lib/enums.ts, src/lib/domain-types.ts, drizzle/** migrations, src/server/db/migrate.ts. Existing tables (users, warehouses, clients, products, locations, inventory, shipment_orders, order_lines, purchase_orders, purchase_order_lines, jobs, audit_log) only gain columns or widen enums. New tables: roles, role_permissions, user_roles, user_warehouses, user_clients, user_sessions, password_reset_tokens, rate_limits, user_printers, user_grid_prefs, saved_views, company_settings, apps, notifications, addresses, customers, vendors, retailers, lookup_values, code_sequences, change_log, tags, entity_tags, custom_field_defs, files, attachments, entity_notes, background_tasks, import_batches, import_rows, printout_templates, printout_template_clients, screen_configs, product_pack_types, product_barcodes, kit_components, product_replenishment_levels, product_channel_allocations, product_listings, serial_numbers, serial_transactions, location_product_capacity, location_lp_capacity, lp_types, license_plates, mobile_carts, mobile_cart_cells, shipment_packages, shipment_package_clients, inventory_transactions, inventory_allocations, inventory_snapshots, receipts, missing_log, order_line_shortages, shipments, shipment_items, end_of_day_manifests, shipment_plans, shipment_plan_orders, return_orders, return_order_lines, job_types, job_orders, tasks, wave_rules, waves, allocation_exceptions, count_plans, count_plan_lines, count_line_entries, work_orders, work_order_components, kit_inventory_stats, algorithms, algorithm_rules, workflows, workflow_runs, rate_shopping_presets, rate_shopping_preset_services, channel_connections, channel_location_mappings, channel_methods, channel_runs, channel_run_items, channel_missing_orders, carrier_connections, carrier_connection_clients, carrier_services, carrier_packages, carrier_third_party_accounts, carrier_call_logs, billing_contracts, billing_fees, billing_fee_tiers, billing_reports, billing_report_lines, vas_operations.

F2 seed: src/server/db/seed.ts, seed-data.ts, seed-builders.ts, seed-orders.ts and src/server/db/seed/** (one file per domain). Seeding is deterministic and replays the domain operations, so the ledger reconciles. It covers every new entity, all 18 lookup types, roles/permissions, carriers (sandbox), channels, waves, counts, work orders, returns, billing, printout templates, snapshots and notifications. scripts/verify-ledger.ts enforces the invariants.

F3 server platform: src/server/api/{define-route.ts,errors.ts,envelope.ts}, src/server/api-utils.ts (shim), src/server/auth/{session.ts,csrf.ts,permissions.ts,permission-catalog.ts,scope.ts,rate-limit.ts,password.ts,password-policy.ts}, src/server/query/{grid-query.ts,filters.ts,sort.ts,paginate.ts,date-presets.ts}, src/server/log.ts, src/middleware.ts, src/app/api/{health,auth/**,me}. Features: JWT jti plus session version for revocation, double-submit CSRF, a durable SQLite rate limiter, the full permission tree from spec 08 with 4 default role sets, warehouse/client scoping, role restrictions redaction, and the URL grid grammar (q/qm, f.<field>=op:value, sort, page, ps up to 1000).

F4 client platform: src/lib/** (api-client.ts, query-client.tsx, use-url-state.ts, format.ts, countries.ts, status-colors.ts, integration-errors.ts, channel-catalog.ts, permissions-client.ts, keyboard.ts, scan.ts); src/components/ui/** (dialog, confirm-dialog, drawer with unsaved guard, toast, tooltip, popover, dropdown-menu, tabs, segmented, yes-no-toggle, radio-cards, select, combobox with min-chars async, date/datetime/time pickers, number-input, text-field/textarea with counters, chip-input, color-swatch, file-dropzone, badge, status-pill, progress-ring, empty-state, callout, barcode, form/*, wizard/*); src/components/grid/** (data-grid rewrite with server sort, resize/reorder/pin, persisted column chooser, density, page sizes 100-1000, virtualization; search-mode Equal/Starts With; filter-builder with New/Saved, typed editors and 18 date presets; chips +N; saved-views; async export; cells); src/components/shared/** (change-log-drawer, tag-popover and create-tag-modal, custom-fields drawer/section, print-options-modal, document-upload-modal, import-page, address-form, product-search-add, entity-pickers, order-picker-drawer, record-picker-modal, create-job-modal, record-summary-rail, activity-timeline, notes-panel); src/app/layout.tsx, globals.css, (app)/layout.tsx, error/not-found/loading/forbidden pages, (app)/imports/[key], (app)/notifications, (app)/dev/ui, login and forgot/reset pages, public/logos/**.

F4 shell and navigation: src/components/layout/** includes app-shell (7 permission-filtered mega-menus), global-search (Pages plus Records), transactions-tray, printers-popover, notifications-bell, help-menu, user-menu, context-switcher (warehouse/client), page-header and breadcrumbs. src/config/nav-config.ts maps every Logiwa menu item to a KitStaks route and owner (BUILD_PLAN F4.7). src/config/page-tabs.ts defines 20 route-based tab groups (F4.6).

F5 domain engines in src/server/domain/**:
- sequences, change-log (field-level, human labels), state-machines (with canTransition reasons)
- ledger: the only inventory writer; 18 transaction types; location and LP mixing rules; receipts; serials
- atp; allocation (algorithm rule evaluation, shortages, allocation exceptions)
- jobs (createJobsFromOrders, merge, cancel, assign, priority) and tasks (execute/update/cancel; picking, packing, sorting and loading handlers; pick-short handling)
- shipping: rateShop, createLabel, void, return label, shipOrders, closeEndOfDay
- carriers/adapter.ts plus a deterministic sandbox carrier with real PDF/ZPL labels
- address-verification, notify, workflows engine, putaway (suggestLocations plus dynamicReplenishmentTargets)
- orders commands: create, update, cancel, hold, release, changeWarehouse, backorder, delete, unmerge
- products minimal create

F6 platform services: src/server/files.ts, src/server/exports/** (runner plus gridKey provider registry, xlsx), src/server/imports/** (parser, registry, per-key handler stubs, template generator, row results and error file), src/server/print/** (render.ts plus templates for all 25 printout types), src/server/scheduler/** (30s runner with lease, snapshot and exports-cleanup tasks, module task stubs), src/server/search/** (registry, Pages provider, record provider stubs).

Stub handoff files created by foundation and owned by modules (BUILD_PLAN 0.6):
- import handlers per entity
- task-handlers/{count,replenishment,kitting}.ts
- scheduler/tasks/{wave-rules,channel-methods,billing-periods,kit-inventory-recalc}.ts
- search/providers/*.ts
- workflows/actions/*.ts
- exports/providers/<gridKey>.ts
- components/products/product-create-drawer.tsx (M09)
- components/vendors/vendor-drawer.tsx (M05)
- repositories/counts-commands.ts (M07)
- repositories/work-orders-commands.ts (M08)

F8 gate:
- Fresh clone: db:reset, db:verify, build, test, lint and typecheck all pass.
- Every nav route resolves, using the only allowed placeholder.
- RBAC, CSRF and session-revocation checks pass.
- /dev/ui gallery is signed off by the critic.
- Shell passes the dead-click audit.
- Domain unit coverage is at least 90%.
- Ledger scenario reconciles: receive, putaway, allocate, pick, pack, label, ship, return, adjust, count.

modules.title: M01 Shipment Orders: Backlog, Shipped & Canceled, Create/Edit 6-step wizard
checklist: Backlog /orders: all 58 columns are available with a sensible default-visible set; 67 filter fields including 10 custom-field slots and Tag; Equal/Starts With search; status pills with a P partial pill; links to order and job.
Header: Import dropdown (/imports/shipment-orders, /imports/shipment-orders-update, /imports/so-serials) and a Create Shipment Order button going to /orders/new. Empty state shows 2 CTA cards.

Bulk Label menu:
- Create Label: shipping-ops labels, then a PDF opens in a new tab.
- Reprint and Void use Logiwa's guard copy.
- Create Return Label.
- Create/Reprint Retailer Label: enabled only when the order has a retailer.

Bulk Warehouse Ops menu:
- Ship Order (confirm table).
- Create Backorder (splits lines into a child order).
- Picking/Job Operations via create-job-modal (merge or new).
- Cancel Picking (guarded).
- Change Warehouse (warning; skips orders with jobs).
- Cancel Order (reason required, from a lookup).
- Put on Hold / Release.
- Resolve Pick Short / Resolve Pack Short (enabled only when Open).
- Unmerge.
Bulk Print menu: Picking List and Batch Picking List (guarded), Packing Slip, Manifest/BOL, Pick/Pack Short Label (shows the ineligible modal). All go through print-options-modal.

Other bulk and row actions:
- Delete menu: Delete Shipment Order (only Open orders with no job; soft delete; confirm table) and Remove Serial Number.
- Tag popover.
- Row menu: Show Details / Edit / Delete.

Shipped & Canceled tab (/orders/shipped):
- Default chip: Actual Shipment Date, Last 7 days.
- Columns: merged SO code, merged status, cancel reason, cancel date.
- Bulk Update Return Info drawer.
- Label menu: Create Return Label, Void Return Label, Reprint.
- Create RMA links to /orders/returns/new?orderIds=.
- Print menu.

Create wizard /orders/new (linear mode). Right rail shows the progress ring, Summary and Save Order. Steps:
- Order Details: auto order code with regenerate link and inline uniqueness check; order type from lookup; dates; note; priority.
- Customer & Address: customer search (3 characters, prefill); Skip Address Verification; Address Type; 247 countries plus 62 US states; tax type; billing radio; Verify Address with attention state.
- Products: product-search-add with live ATP; Create New Product via M09 drawer; KPI chips; find by SKU; lines grid with all columns; Edit line drawer with UOM, price, qty, live available pack qty, read-only allocation quantities, lot/expiry/damage/location/LP pinning, line notes and custom fields.
- Shipping: carrier and service cascade or rate-shopping preset; Get Rates table; billing types; custom account toggles; packing instructions; package; cost; tracking chip input; export reason; Return (BETA) section.
- Other Info: extra notes 1-5, client reference, fraud, packing warning, gift and gift note, grouping ref, retailer block, custom fields.
- Confirm: cards, then save via domain orders.createOrder (workflows run), then a success screen with 3 cards.

Detail/Edit /orders/[id] (free mode):
- Warehouse and client are locked; lines lock once picking starts.
- Save button and an Other Actions menu (Ship, Delete, Cancel, Hold/Release, Duplicate), each gated by canTransition with a reason.
- Summary card: Show Change Log, Last Update, totals.
- Assigned Jobs card: + opens create-job-modal; x unassigns.
- Billing Charges download.
- Printouts card: availability of each document, plus document upload.
- Packages & Tracking panel; activity timeline; notes; workflow-blocked banner with Release.

APIs:
- GET/POST /api/orders?view=backlog|shipped
- GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/orders/[id]
- line CRUD
- verify-address and code-check
- POST /api/orders/bulk/{cancel,hold,release,change-warehouse,delete,backorder,resolve-pick-short,resolve-pack-short,unmerge,cancel-picking,update-return-info,remove-serials}

All use permission keys and optimistic concurrency.
Import handlers (orders with grouped lines, bulk update, serials) and a search provider for code, store order #, tracking and customer.
Delete the SYNTH timeline, the ReadField displays and the local tab state.
acceptance: Wizard creates KS-E2E-SO-1 with 2 SKUs, a new customer and an unverified address. Step 2 shows the attention state until Verify Address normalizes it (Arkansas becomes AR, line 2 merged). After save, the order is Open in the Backlog, its weight comes from the product master, and the Change Log has the Create entry plus the line entries with human labels.
Picking/Job Ops, Create New Job moves the order to Ready to Pick. The Assigned Jobs card shows the job. Delete and Cancel are disabled with reason tooltips. ATP drops by the allocated quantity.
Cancel Order is blocked until a reason is chosen. After cancel, the order is in the Shipped & Canceled tab with reason and date, allocations are released, and ATP is restored.
Reprint/Void Label on an order without a label shows Logiwa's exact guard copy. Change Warehouse reports the orders it skipped because they have jobs.
Create Backorder on an order with a short line produces a child order (masterOrderId) that carries the short line.
A filtered view (Status in Open, a client, Order Date Last 7 days) round-trips through its URL in a new tab. The Excel export row count equals Total.
A 50-row import with 2 bad rows ends Partially Successful (48/2), and the Details drawer lists the row errors.
Saving from two tabs makes the second save return 409 with a Reload prompt. Global search on a tracking number finds the order.
A0 universal criteria pass, and the critic is wowed in a blind side-by-side against Logiwa's Shipment Order list and Create wizard.

Print End of the Day Report closes the manifest (Closed, close date, Printed Yes) and opens a PDF listing the packages with barcodes. A later label opens a new Open manifest.

Shipment plan KS-E2E-SP-1 with 2 orders: the status popover shows only legal next statuses. Ship moves both orders to Shipped, the plan becomes Shipped with an actual shipment date, and the Plan Orders tab reflects this.
Shipment History quantities equal the ledger Shipment transactions per lot/LP.

modules.title: M03 Jobs, Wave Rules, Wave Log, Allocation Exceptions, Shortage, Task Details, Job Types
modules.specRefs: 02-fulfillment-ops.md §0-§7 and Key business logic; 07-reports-analytics.md §Shortage, §Wave Log, §Allocation Exceptions; 08-settings-shell.md §Job Types, §Roles
checklist:
Job Management (/jobs):
- 32 columns, 31 filters; default chip Job Status in Pending, Started.
- Bulk: Update Priority (attention modal with None/Low/Medium/High cards); Cancel (releases allocations); User Actions Assign/Unassign (3-character user search, different-warehouses guard dialog); Label menu; Print menu with 5 documents and their guards.
- Job Code links to /jobs/[id].
Job detail page /jobs/[id] (Logiwa has none): header with progress, plus Orders, Tasks, Pick Path and Timeline tabs, and every action.

Wave Rules grid (/jobs/wave-rules):
- Live NEXT RUN countdown.
- Run bulk action: toast with the wave result, a notification, and a link to the log.
- Row menu: Show Details / Edit / Change Log / Delete.

Wave Rule wizard. Operation-type chooser with 5 cards (AI Job gated by the AI Jobs app). Steps:
1. General: name, warehouse, priority & delete options accordion, drag-sortable numbered job-type list.
2. Selection: 36 filter fields with typed editors, plus Order By.
3. Schedule: day chips; Set Time popover with Specific Time or Period; times grid; daily frequency counter; validation.
4. Assign: Pool / Roles / Users grids with toggles.

Wave Rule variants:
- Cycle Count (count type, lock locations): calls counts-commands.
- Replenishment (soft allocation): uses putaway.dynamicReplenishmentTargets.
- Order Merge (merge rules, no Assign step).

Wave execution engine (waves-run.ts):
1. Wave number in the form <ruleSeq>-<runCount>.
2. Status lifecycle.
3. Filter and sort the orders.
4. Match job types in precedence order.
5. allocation.allocateOrders, then jobs.createJobsFromOrders.
6. Write counts; invariant: met = allocated + shortage.

The scheduler runs rules in the warehouse timezone with runBy=Integration and supports delete-if-not-started.

Report-style grids:
- Allocation Exceptions: tooltips; Retry Allocation.
- Wave Log: 8 statuses; links to jobs filtered by wave.
- Shortage Report: 25 columns; red reason text with tooltip; Retry Allocation; Create Backorder.

Task Details (/tasks/order-operations, /tasks/count, /tasks/replenishment):
- Order Operations: 67 columns, 49 filters. Task Operations menu: Execute (target location*, LPN, quantity, partial-execute pick-short), Update (target location, To LPN, move job), Cancel. User Actions: Assign/Unassign.
- Count: 48 columns, read-only.
- Replenishment: 50 columns, Cancel Task.

Job Types grid (/settings/job-types): row menu with delete guard.

Picking wizard (5 steps):
- General: allocation algorithm select, filtered by warehouse.
- Templates: 9 cards that preset the settings.
- Settings: order scope, 10 flags with dependencies, batch size, exclusive mobile screens.
- Conditions: Order By picking method, draggable, asc/desc, Walking Path default.
- Grouping.

Other job-type wizards: Count (4 steps), Replenishment (3 steps; FEFO/FIFO, flow, type, 4 condition sections), Work Order (3 steps).
Replenishment task handler: pick phase and put phase, LP swap, pack-type conversion, ledger Replenishment.
acceptance: With 10 Open MLT1 orders, rule KS-E2E Picking (Single Unit, then Multi Item; Order Qty 1-10) is Run. The Wave Log row shows met = allocated + shortage. Jobs are created per type. Allocation Exceptions lists eliminated orders using Logiwa's explanation strings. The orders become Ready to Pick and ATP drops.
Scheduling the rule for now+2 minutes: the countdown ticks down and it auto-runs with Run By = Integration.
Update Priority to High shows a red High pill on every selected job. Assigning across MLT1 and KS2 shows the Different Warehouses dialog.

Executing every pick task of an order moves it Picking Started, then Ready to Pack. Picking transactions appear in Transaction History. A partial execute writes a missing-log row and sets Pick Short = Open.
Creating a Picking job type from the Single Item Order template presets the scope. Deleting a job type that is in use is blocked with a reason.

Every jobs-group tab and every nav link (Wave Rules, Shortage, Wave Log, Allocation Exceptions) deep-links correctly. A0 universal criteria pass, and the critic is wowed against Logiwa's Jobs, Wave Rules and Task Details.

modules.title: M04 Packing Station, Return Station, Return Orders & RMA
modules.specRefs: 02-fulfillment-ops.md §9 Packing Station, §10 Return Station; 01-orders.md §5 Return Orders; 08-settings-shell.md §Roles (Packing Station, Return Station, Return Orders)
checklist:
Packing dashboard (/packing-station):
- Warehouse and packing station selection (packing-area locations, remembered per user).
- 4 start buttons.
- Real KPIs and a user card.

Pack screen (/packing-station/[stationId]/[mode]):
- Left pane: Tote/Location/Order/Putwall tabs; wedge scan input; List & Select modal with filters; job and order cards with x/y counters; product scan.
- Right pane:
  - Package type auto-fills dimensions; contents grid; wrong item gives a beep and red toast; over-pack is blocked.
  - Serial and lot/expiry capture.
  - Weight in lb/oz; multi-box; Close Pack.
  - Carrier/service with Get Rate; pre-generated label upload.

Other Actions menu: Report Issue (moves items to the hospital location; Pack Short Open), Print Actions, Pack Without Label.

Complete Packing And Create Label:
1. Ledger Packing.
2. Labels.
3. Print label and packing slip.
4. Ready to Ship, or auto-ship.
5. Packaging material consumption.

Error toasts match Logiwa. Keyboard shortcuts: Enter, F2, F9.

Return Station dashboard (/return-station): warehouse, return-station picker (returns area, scan), target location/LP, Return With RMA and Return Manually (disabled with a reason until a station is chosen), KPIs.

Return With RMA flow: scan the RMA, order or tracking number, then per item set quantity, disposition (Restock / Damaged / Quarantine / Dispose), actual reason and photo. Completing it writes Return receipts and ledger Return Receiving, updates line and RMA status, and notifies.

Return Manually: client, optional order, products, then a Manual RMA.

Return Orders grid (/orders/returns):
- One row per RMA line, 25 columns, 23 filters, 5 pills.
- Change Status modal offering legal transitions only.
- Tag and export.

Create RMA (/orders/returns/new?orderIds=): select shipped lines (quantity limited to shipped minus already returned), reasons, return carrier/service with Create Return Label via shipping ops, expected date, success screen.
RMA detail (/orders/returns/[id]): lines, receipts, label, timeline, Change Status, Cancel, Reprint Return Label.
acceptance: A Ready to Pack MLT1 order is packed at PACK-01 using only the scanner and keyboard. A wrong SKU is rejected with a beep and red toast. The package auto-fills dimensions, Get Rate shows a sandbox rate, and Complete opens the label PDF. The order becomes Ready to Ship and the shipment appears in /shipments.
Two packages produce a master tracking number plus 2 child numbers. Report Issue moves stock to the hospital location and sets the order's Pack Short Status to Open.

An RMA for 1 of 2 shipped units, with a return label, shows as Pending. Receiving it at the Return Station as Restock into MLT1-RTN completes the RMA. A Return receipt appears in Receiving History, Return Receiving in Transaction History, and +1 at MLT1-RTN in Inventory by Location.
Change Status offers only legal transitions, and a Cancelled RMA cannot be received.
A0 universal criteria pass, and the critic is wowed against Logiwa's Packing Station, Return Station and Return Orders.

checklist:
PO list (/receiving):

Create wizard /receiving/new (5 steps). Right rail shows the PO Status ring, a live Price, and Confirm.
1. PO Details: inline PO-number uniqueness check.
2. Products: 3-character search with qty stepper; Edit Product drawer (pack type, qty, price, read-only total, receiving details enabled by tracking flags); Create New Product via M09 drawer; 17-column lines grid; chips; empty state.
3. Vendor: client-scoped grid; Add New Vendor via vendor-drawer; edit pencil; single select.
4. Other Info: custom fields.
5. Confirm: duplicate banner, then a success screen with 3 cards.

PO detail (/receiving/[id]):

- Other Actions (Receive / Delete / Cancel), gated by status.

- Billing charges download; Printouts with document upload and view.

Receive Items wizard (beyond Logiwa: partial receiving on web). Per line:
- Quantity.
- Location, with a putaway suggestion and its reason.
- LP: scan an existing one or create a new one.
- Lot / expiry / production date, required according to tracking flags and screen config.
- Damage reason plus photo; serials (count must equal qty); note.

Over-receipt needs confirmation. The wizard calls ledger.recordReceipt, which drives the PO status Started or Completed.

Receiving History (/receiving/history):
- 34 columns, 25 filters.
- Master Id opens a receipt drawer.
- Row Cancel: confirm, then reverse, blocked when the PO is Completed (Logiwa error copy).

Vendors (/receiving/vendors and /organization/vendors):
- Grid with a filter for client/company/nickname.
- Drawer: client locked on edit; display name (100) and vendor name (255) with inline errors; ship/billing toggle; addresses.
- Change Log; deactivate guard.
Import PO handler (creates missing vendors) and a search provider for PO codes and reference numbers.
acceptance: The wizard creates KS-E2E-PO-1 (2 lines) with a new vendor created in the drawer, then shows the success screen. The PO is Pending with Purchase Price = sum of qty x price. A duplicate PO number is flagged inline on step 1.

Partial receive of 6/10 into the suggested location with lot L123 and expiry +180 days:
- PO becomes Started.
- 1 Purchase Order receipt row.
- Inventory by Location shows 6 units at that location with lot L123.
- Transaction History shows a Receiving transaction.
- PO Receiving Report shows -4 as a red pill.
